interface.title: LQL-Equiv 3.0 — Equivalent doses in radiotherapy
interface.stage_of_work: Designing and comparing fractionation schedules before treatment, for teaching and research (re-irradiation, hypofractionation, treatment gaps). Explicitly not for clinical use.
interface.what_it_is_for: Convert any multi-course radiotherapy schedule into biologically effective dose (BED) and equivalent dose in a reference fractionation (EQD2) for one organ at risk and one tumour together, using the linear-quadratic-linear model, and estimate NTCP, TCP and radiation-induced cancer risk.

data.note: A built-in radiobiological library (the About tab says 34 organs at risk and 20 tumour sites). Each entry carries α/β, α, transition dose, repair half-time, Tk, Tp, Dprol and NTCP/TCP parameters. Defaults on load: Rectum / Prostate, 25 × 2 Gy, reference 2 Gy. Nothing is uploaded and there is no sign-in.

tree.general: Compare treatment schedules on a common biological-effect scale for a sensitive tissue and a target tissue, and estimate harm, benefit and second-cancer risk
tree.specific: Compute BED/EQD2, NTCP, TCP and the radiation-induced cancer risk coefficient for an organ at risk and a tumour under the LQ-L model, and compare fractionation schedules
